verdict.rationale: Missive's own docs say it manages "email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more in one shared inbox," and pricing lists "Email, SMS, social accounts." The API reference handles WhatsApp messages in conversations, and the developer tools include custom channels, so non-email channels sit beside email in the team inbox. Missing for 10: any evidence of live chat, in-depth setup docs for each channel (SMS providers, specific social networks), and independent or hands-on corroboration of multichannel use.
